senses.gloss: as preced. Hif.—Y. Shek. VII, 50ᶜ bot. [read:] חמתון מקילין לון וחַ׳ וכ׳ he saw them to be lax in their practices, and he enjoined strictness on them.
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 88a:10">Yeb. 88ᵃ</cite> <he>לא לִיחַמֵּיר וכ׳</he> let one not put her under heavy restrictions (in the end), and not make it too easy for her (in the beginning, v. <cite ref="H01218">preced.</cite>).

Nidd. 66ᵃ היכא דאַחְמוּר וכ׳ in those cases in which they have placed themselves under greater restrictions (than the law requires, v. preced.), they have done so (and follow the usage like a law), but where they have not &c. (you cannot extend the adopted usage by analogy); a. fr.—Part. pass. מַחְמַר, מְחַמַּר piled up, ruins; v. מַחְמר a. דִּמְחַמְרָא.

senses.gloss: to be piled up, to form a pile of ruins (cmp. גַּל).
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 17:9">Targ. Is. XVII, 9</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 30:13">XXX, 13</cite>.
